title: पारिभाषित आँखा उपन्यासमा शरीरमाथि उपभोक्तावादी संस्कृतिको प्रभाव र प्रयोग
nepali: प्रस्तुत शोधलेख पारिजातद्वारा लेखिएको पारिभाषित आँखाहरू उपन्यासमा चित्रित शरीर राजनीतिअन्तर्गत शरीरमाथि उपभोक्तावादी संस्कृतिको प्रभाव र प्रयोगको अध्ययनसँग सम्बद्घ छ । यसमा शक्तिशाली वर्गले शक्तिहीन वर्गको शरीरमाथि गर्ने शोषण तथा दमनका साथै शक्तिशाली वर्गले आफ्नो अनुकूलको विमर्शद्वारा केकसरी कमजोर वर्गको शरीरमाथि शासन गरी कमोडिटीका रूपमा रूपान्तरण गरेको छ भन्ने जिज्ञासाको समाधान खोज्ने प्रयत्न गरिएको छ । यसका लागि शरीरमाथि उपभोक्तावादी संस्कृतिको प्रभाव र प्रयोगसम्बन्धी मान्यतालाई कृतिविश्लेषणको मुख्य आधार बनाइएको छ । अध्ययनका अन्त्यमा शक्तिशाली वर्गले विभिन्न विमर्शमार्फत नारी शरीरको विनिर्माण गरी वस्तुमा रूपान्तरण गरेको सन्दर्भलाई सघन रूपमा उठाएको छ । शक्तिहीन वर्गले आफ्नो स्व जोगाउनका लागि गरेको प्रतिरोध असफल भएको सन्दर्भ यथार्थका साथ प्रस्तुत गरेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This research article is concerned with the study of the impact and operation of consumer culture on the body under body politics depicted in Parijat's novel Paribhashit Aankhaharu. In this, an attempt is made to address the question of how the powerful class exploits and oppresses the bodies of the powerless class, and how the powerful class rules over the bodies of the weak class through self-serving discourse to transform them into commodities. For this purpose, theoretical notions regarding the influence and application of consumer culture on the body are made the primary basis for analyzing the work. Toward the end of the study, the context of how the powerful class deconstructs the female body through various discourses and transforms it into an object is raised intensively. The conclusion is drawn that the failure of the resistance mounted by the powerless class to preserve its selfhood has been realistically presented.

australian_english: This research article focuses on studying the impact and operation of consumerist culture on the body within the body politics depicted in Parijat's novel Paribhashit Aankhaharu. In this, an effort is made to tackle the question of how the powerful class exploits and oppresses the bodies of the powerless class, and how the powerful class rules over the bodies of the weaker class through tailored discourse to turn them into commodities. For this purpose, theoretical notions regarding the impact and application of consumerist culture on the body are made the primary basis for analysing the work. Towards the end of the study, the issue of how the powerful class deconstructs the female body through diverse discourses and turns it into an object is brought up in depth. The conclusion is drawn that the failure of the resistance put up by the powerless class to protect its selfhood has been realistically depicted.
informal_english: This research paper is all about digging into how consumer culture acts on and uses the body under the body politics depicted in Parijat's novel Paribhashit Aankhaharu. Here, it tries to sort out how the mob in power exploits and oppresses the bodies of the powerless, and how they use self-serving discourse to rule over weaker folks' bodies and turn them into commodities. To do that, theoretical ideas about how consumer culture affects and uses the body are taken as the main framework for pulling the book apart. Towards the end of the study, it zeroes right in on how the powerful deconstruct the female body through all sorts of discourse and turn it into a mere object. The takeaway is that the novel realistically shows how the powerless mob's struggle to hang onto their own identity ends up failing completely.
translator_notes: The novel title 'Paribhashit Aankhaharu' (पारिभाषित आँखाहरू, Parijat) is transliterated; strict 5-sentence order and terminology ('कमोडिटी' as commodity, 'विमर्श' as discourse) preserved.
